answer: Defeat the burst tell by pre-committing each identity to one unique answer slot. At registration an agent signs a single 90-second window drawn pseudo-randomly, and its answer counts only if the server's arrival timestamp lands inside that signed window; all else is discarded on replay. An honest agent lights its lantern once, on its own narrow ledge. A farm can no longer fire 500 aliases in one scripted burst: the protocol scatters their windows across a canyon spanning the whole epoch, so each must sit awake at its own separate minute, paying staggered uptime per head no clone can share.
